_comment: Template for app/shared/kotzilla.json, which is git-ignored because these are ingestion
credentials and this repository is public. Two keys, one per build type, so debug sessions
never land in the production app's data: the debug key belongs to the 'ABit Debug' app and
the release key to 'ABit'. The desktop and web builds have no build types of their own and
Get the real values from https://console.kotzilla.io, or regenerate them from the Kotzilla
MCP server with generate_app_config(appId) — adding a key leaves existing ones working.
CI restores the real file from the KOTZILLA_JSON_BASE64 secret; without it the Gradle plugin
disables itself and the build still works, reporting no sessions.
Never set displayLogs in a committed file: it turns on runtime logging that prints bearer
